# mapbox_token (List Resource)

List the access tokens owned by a mapbox account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "mapbox_token" "example" {
  provider = mapbox

  config {
    username = "example"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) The username of the account whose tokens should be listed.
